title: The fall and the rise of Weyl gauge theory
summary: In 1918 Weyl introduced Weyl conformal geometry and its associated quadratic action which was the first gauge theory, of the Weyl group (of dilatations and Poincaré symmetry). The initial physical interpretation of his theory was however short-lived and led to the downfall of Weyl geometry as a physical theory. We review how this action was re-born into a physical Weyl quadratic gauge theory of gravity.
